scope: Retain typed SPATIAL_FILTER callbacks in converter-owned storage
Retain complete DXF raw companions with bounded generation-bound accounting

localEvidence: Generated ASCII and Binary DXF inputs each import one SPATIAL_FILTER and retain one typed callback plus one raw companion
The import receipt binds generation, source format/version, record ranges, callback/group counts, estimated retained bytes, and typed/raw handle-owner identity
The existing dwg2dxf_named_object_callback_storage CTest verifies fail-closed export preserves an existing destination

assessment.planImpact: Closes bounded callback/raw capture and safe refusal only. Owner-graph closure and serializer admission remain the next local slices; capture does not qualify clipping semantics or format support.

focusedSelectors.name: --dxf-geodata-modern-text-preflight
focusedSelectors.failure: Two unrelated GEODATA newline-to-caret-J assertions fail for AC1021 and AC1032 ASCII; Binary cases pass. The baseline provenance of this dirty worktree failure is unverified.

method.limitations: DXF owner-graph closure and replay are not implemented. DWG callback provenance is supported by the capture path but no committed DWG fixture or native consumer qualification was added.

nextAction: Implement PAR-139.3 order-independent INSERT-extension-dictionary-ACAD_FILTER-SPATIAL owner closure with generated positive and negative controls. Keep the isolated GEODATA ASCII assertion failure visible as a separate test issue.
